title.narrative: Advancing Inclusive and Ethical AI Governance in Lebanon and Syria

description.narrative: This activity supports the advancement of inclusive, ethical and accountable AI governance frameworks in complex contexts, grounded in UNESCO’s Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence. It provides demand-driven, context-sensitive assistance to strengthen human rights-based and participatory approaches, including through AI Readiness Assessments, capacity-building, and support to national AI policies and strategies. It also facilitates engagement with UNESCO’s global AI ethics networks for peer learning and knowledge exchange.
